summary.en: Absolute comes from Latin absolutus, the past participle of absolvere ‘set free, complete’. Its sol-/solve relationship is historical; 炒 chǎo is not.

claim.en: Absolute comes from Latin absolutus, the past participle of absolvere ‘set free, complete’. Its sol-/solve relationship is historical; 炒 chǎo is not.
claim.zh-Hans: absolute 来自拉丁语 absolutus，是 absolvere“释放、完成”的过去分词；其与 sol-／solve 的关系有历史依据，与“炒”chǎo 则没有。

summary.en: Solve and 炒 chǎo are not close phonetic equivalents under a regular sound correspondence.
summary.zh-Hans: solve 与“炒”chǎo 不构成规律音变下的近似。
